name: bunframe
description: A desktop application shell for Bun: native windows via wry driven entirely from TypeScript, through the bffi binding.

scripts.codegen: cargo run --release --bin emit-json && bunx @z2net/bffi-cli@0.2.3 codegen .bffi/bffi.api.json -o .bffi/api.gen.ts && bun run scripts/sync-api-gen.ts
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && bun test
